points.point: Battle card 的競品比較本質是 sales positioning，不是可引用的技術規格
points.label: covered
points.why: states battle cards/internal comparisons are sales views, not formal or verifiable specifications

points.point: 對競品的主張只有 R&S 內部 battle card 單一來源，對外使用前須補競品官方資料與第三方證據
points.label: covered
points.why: requires official competitor documentation and third-party evidence before customer use

points.point: battle card 數字不可當作 binding specifications，引用時只能標示為特定日期的 sales claim，並等待正式規格文件
points.label: partial
points.why: says battle-card/TCO/price claims are not verifiable specs and need formal support, but does not clearly say to label them as dated sales claims while awaiting formal specs

points.point: AI 相關的 R&S 自動化工具（AI Script Assistant / CONTEST）在 battle card 中未提供文件版次，Keysight toolchain 需官方資料
points.label: partial
points.why: generally asks for AI/toolchain official docs, versions, releases, but does not name AI Script Assistant, CONTEST, or Keysight Atlas, nor state their exact evidence gaps

points.point: CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant 的能力只有 PR 說法，缺 benchmark、correctness metric、coverage matrix 與驗證條件
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions missing measurement conditions/test scope, but not that CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant is PR-only or lacks benchmark, correctness metric, coverage matrix, and validation conditions

points.point: non-signaling / production 平台的能力主張，必須分別引用各平台的正式 source page
points.label: partial
points.why: asks for formal R&S datasheets/configuration evidence, but does not specifically say each non-signaling/production platform must be cited from its own official source page

points.point: 競品官方 brochure 可用於描述競品，但不可用來驗證 R&S 自家的優勢主張
points.label: partial
points.why: requires competitor official data, but does not state the brochure distinction: usable to describe competitor, not to validate R&S advantage claims

points.point: AI-assisted 測試工作流的價值需用可量測指標衡量，而 PR 語言未提供量化 benchmark 或驗證方法
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions AI test requirement evidence and measurement conditions, but not measurable workflow value metrics or that PR lacks quantitative benchmarks/validation methods
